plugin.name: Databases
plugin.description: Browse and edit MySQL, MariaDB, PostgreSQL and SQLite databases on your hosts from one tab.

use.title: Use Databases
use.description: Open the Databases tab and work with databases on hosts you can access.

enable.label: Databases
enable.description: Show the Databases tab for this host in its menu.

showPanel.label: Panel beside the terminal
showPanel.description: Offer a databases panel next to this host's SSH terminal.

companionAutoOpen.label: Open the databases panel with a terminal
companionAutoOpen.description: Show the databases panel when a terminal opens on a host that has it.

companionSide.label: Databases panel side
companionSide.description: Where the panel sits next to the terminal.

companionSize.label: Databases panel size
companionSize.description: Width, or height at the bottom, in pixels.

companionEdgeButton.label: Databases panel edge button
companionEdgeButton.description: Show a small button on the terminal edge to open the panel.

tab.title: Databases
tab.error: Could not load Databases from this host.
tab.sudo: This host needs passwordless sudo to run commands as another user.
tab.noTools: No database client was found on this host. Install mysql, psql or sqlite3 to use this tab.
tab.emptyHint: Add a login for a database that runs on this host or can be reached from it.

conn.name: Name
conn.clientMissing: The client for this database type was not found on the host.
conn.fileHint: Full path of the SQLite file on the host.
conn.addressHint: Leave empty to use the local socket.
conn.passwordSaved: A password is saved. Leave this empty to keep it.
conn.passwordHint: Leave empty for socket or peer login.
conn.databaseHint: Optional. The database to open first.
conn.runAsHint: Optional. Runs the client as this user with sudo, for example postgres. Needs passwordless sudo.
conn.readOnlyDesc: Block changes made through this login in Termix. The database user's own rights still apply.
conn.deleteDesc: This removes the saved login from Termix. The database is not touched.

browse.pick: Pick a table on the left.
